outcomes.question: Give me the average cassava price observed in Ghanaian markets in 2021.
price_sql: SELECT f.price_avg, f.common_unit_price_avg, f.market_count, f.year, f.month, f.country_name, f.price_type, f.price_source, d0.product_name, d1.organisation_name FROM (SELECT price_avg, common_unit_price_avg, market_count, year, month, country_name, price_type, price_source, product_key, source_key FROM `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.agg_prices_country_month` WHERE country_name = 'Ghana' AND year = 2021 AND product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_product` WHERE product_name = 'Cassava') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 50) AS f LEFT JOIN `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_product` AS d0 ON d0.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_source` AS d1 ON d1.source_key = f.source_key ORDER BY f.month DESC

SELECT f.value, f.year, f.month, f.as_of_date, f.metric, f.price_type, f.price_source, f.currency, f.unit, d0.product_name, d1.organisation_name, d2.market_name, d3.unit_code FROM (SELECT value, year, month, as_of_date, metric, price_type, price_source, currency, unit, product_key, source_key, market_key, unit_key FROM `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.fct_prices` WHERE country_iso3 = 'GHA' AND as_of_date BETWEEN DATE '2021-01-01' AND DATE '2021-12-31' AND product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_product` WHERE product_name = 'Cassava') AND as_of_date BETWEEN DATE '2021-01-01' AND DATE '2021-12-31' ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, month DESC LIMIT 50) AS f LEFT JOIN `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_product` AS d0 ON d0.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_source` AS d1 ON d1.source_key = f.source_key LEFT JOIN `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_market` AS d2 ON d2.market_key = f.market_key LEFT JOIN `opentrace-prod-5ga4.mart_dev.dim_unit` AS d3 ON d3.unit_key = f.unit_key ORDER BY f.as_of_date DESC, f.month DESC
outcomes.answer_head: The average retail cassava price observed in Ghanaian markets in December 2021 was 2.52 units.
